failure_signature: One convenient scenario presented as general behaviour.
control: Use ROUTE_SELECTOR_MIN or FULL and name the unit, evidence and prohibited inference.

failure_signature: Access, permission, evidence, time or evaluation burden remains assumed rather than tested.
control: Run the smallest safe feasibility sprint and record continue, narrow, pivot or stop.

failure_signature: One convenient dataset, parameter setting or simulator is treated as proof of general behaviour.
control: Resolve formal definitions, assumptions, known cases, comparator methods, complexity or sensitivity evidence and authoritative implementation details.

failure_signature: Findings remain bounded by assumptions, instances, simulator and protocol.
control: Toy instance, invariant check, sensitivity run or independent baseline.; preserve work-unit provenance and deviations.

failure_signature: One dataset, parameter setting or machine becomes universal superiority or model truth
control: Analytical or known case, reference implementation, convergence or validity challenge; retain counter-evidence and rejected stronger wording.

failure_signature: The thesis, evidence package, demonstration, slides or oral account describes a different route, release, result or claim.
control: Re-run one limiting case, one moderate-load comparison and one adverse near-saturation case, then show the sensitivity table and run manifest. Preserve a same-release fallback and rehearse the hostile question.
